items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a quasi-compact separated etale morphism the counit $f^*f_*\mathcal{F} \to \mathcal{F}$ admits a splitting (statement lines 2021-2026). The proof pulls the pushforward back along the fibre square, uses the fact that the diagonal is at the same time an open and a closed immersion to decompose the pulled back module into the contribution of the diagonal and a module supported on its complement, and then reads off that the resulting composite is the identity; the author displays the composite and leaves the tracing of the maps to the reader. The decomposition along the diagonal is the substance, so the claim is H2.
